result.brief: 提出基于 JEPA 预测世界模型的递归自我改进框架，用世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择，并跨代码修复、GUI、实验室规划等任务验证。
result.reason: Builds on JEPA-Anything with predictive world models for policy/data selection, but abstract emphasizes agentic RSI applications rather than video/multimodal representation or generative world-model contributions.
